items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Kenny Clark was playing with Nathan Davis and them.

ctx.x: In Detroit he heard me. (Scats an extremely fast head) you know, so he heard that. He grabbed my hand and squeezed it, "you play so nice, Curtis Fuller." And so, I didn't think I would end up playing for nobody, you know? Then, in those days, I was working for brother Yusef. When I got to Paris, I walked into the Bluenote. Bud comes up, he wasn’t playing that night. Kenny Clark was playing with Nathan Davis and them. True enough, he comes up and he must've thought I was one of his old buddies or something.…
